description: List your own Canvas page views (URL, time and course) in a time range. Read-only. Useful for showing you opened material on a given date. How far back history goes depends on your school.

end_time.description: End of the range, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

name: get_my_page_views
title: Get My Page Views
